title: Unnai Thedi
desc: Raghu travels to New Zealand with a friend and meets Malavika, whom he falls in love with. However, circumstances force them to part ways.

title: Oru Kaidhiyin Diary
desc: David, a politically active person, is married to Rosy. However, when his political idol, mistreats his wife, he vows to take revenge.

title: Senathipathi
desc: Sethupathi, a young man, falls in love with Lingappan Naicker, the village head's daughter Aishwarya. Meanwhile, the girl's father asks Senathipathi, Sethu's older brother, to protect her.
